meta.title: Haseeb — Accounting software that understands your business.
meta.description: Haseeb is built for Kuwaiti businesses. It prepares the accounting, asks when something is missing, and answers your questions in plain language. Founding cohort now forming.

hero.h1: Get ahead with accounting software that understands your business.
hero.support: Haseeb is built for Kuwaiti businesses.
hero.fact: Founding cohort · 8–12 Kuwaiti businesses · Supervised from day one

how.h2: Haseeb prepares the work. You approve it.
how.intro: Haseeb reads your bank transactions, prepares the accounting, and separates what is clear from what needs your attention.

prepares.label: Prepares
prepares.body: When the information is clear, Haseeb prepares the entry. You approve it, one by one or as a batch.

asks.label: Asks
asks.body: When something is missing, Haseeb asks you one question. Answer it and the entry is ready.

holds.label: Holds
holds.body: When there is not enough information, Haseeb stops. Nothing is posted until you or your accountant decide.

how.close: You stay in control of what gets approved.

ask.h2: Ask your books a question, in plain language.
ask.body: Ask which customers still owe you, or how much cash you have today, and get an answer in plain language.

kuwait.h2: It doesn't just work in Kuwait. It understands Kuwait.
kuwait.body: Kuwaiti merchants. Supported local bank-statement formats. Kuwaiti business and reporting requirements.

cohort.h2: Be one of the first businesses in Kuwait to use Haseeb.
cohort.body: We are selecting 8–12 Kuwaiti service businesses for Haseeb's founding cohort.
bullets: Direct access to the founding team

form.intro: Every application is reviewed personally. No financial information is required to apply.
form.name: Name
form.errEmail: Please add a valid email address.
form.note: This opens your email app with a pre-filled message to founder@haseeb.app. Nothing is sent until you press send there, and nothing is stored on this site. Please don't include financial statements or bank details; we'll never ask for them in this form.
form.success: Your email app should now be open with your application to founder@haseeb.app. Press send there to submit it. If nothing opened, email founder@haseeb.app directly.
form.mailtoTrailer: — sent from the founding-cohort form on haseeb.app

bot.launcher: Talk to Haseeb like you talk to your accountant.
bot.title: HASEEB.
bot.emptySub: I can help you understand your financials, spot issues, and answer questions about your books.
bot.q1: Which unpaid invoices need my attention?
bot.a1: {customerCount} customers have unpaid invoices totalling {openTotal} KWD. The largest open invoice is {largestInvoiceNo} from {largestCustomer}, {largestAmount} KWD.
bot.q2: How much cash do we have right now?
bot.a2: {cash} KWD available across {accountCount} bank accounts, as of {asOfDate}.
bot.q3: What were our revenue, expenses and net income this month?
bot.a3: {month}: revenue {revenue} KWD, operating expenses {opex} KWD, net income {net} KWD. Compared with {prevMonth}: revenue {revenueChangePct}, operating expenses {opexChangePct}, net income {netChangeAbs} KWD {netChangeDir}.
bot.demoBoundary: This is a guided demonstration on sample figures, so I can only answer the suggested questions here. In the product, answers come from your own books.
bot.placeholder: This website demo answers the suggested questions only.
bot.disclaimer: Guided demo on sample data. Answers in the product come from your own books.
